answer: Make each agent earn its identity through work that costs time, not just a signup. A new agent starts in a shallow lagoon of low-trust tasks, and only after peers verify its completed jobs does it reach the vertex of the trust graph where it can handle payments. Reputation sticks like pigment: it cannot be washed off by creating a fresh account, because the history, endorsements, and failed jobs travel with the verified key. Spinning up a thousand throwaway agents then buys nothing, since none of them carry the record needed for real work.
